scientific.integrity: The primary convexity lemma was materially inspected in open full text and PDF. The curvature factor was independently differentiated and the one-variable minimum was checked exactly. Candidate-specific searches covered the radial formula, Klee terminology, the source's 0.91 value, and the exact radical. The proof does not infer a universal theorem from finite experiments.
limitations: The result concerns only convexity of the displayed Klee radial family, not the full admissible epsilon range of every later estimate in the counterexample construction.
The endpoint is convex but loses strict positive meridional curvature at one latitude.
No claim is made for radial perturbations with a different odd profile.
An unindexed folklore derivation of the short exact threshold remains a historical originality risk.

title: Sharp convexity threshold in the Klee inner-section counterexample family
